name: zmodel_material_set_flag_bit9
description: zModel_Material::SetFlagBit9 sets or clears material flag bit 9 from the low bit of the enabled argument and rejects null materials.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; final byte matching should be handled with the coherent zModel material/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x480f60 validates null return 0, clearing bit 9 with mask 0xfdff, setting bit 9 from (enabled & 1) << 9, writing the 16-bit flags field, and returning 1 for non-null materials.
The native smoke verifies null rejection and clearing flag bit 9 while preserving every other material flag bit.
